title: Carried limb multiplication preserves the modular product
summary: For equal n-limb inputs, the generated carry_mulmod operation preserves the product under the weighted positional interpretation modulo s minus the coefficient evaluation.

source.statement: forall (f g : list Z) (Hf : length f = n) (Hg : length g = n), (eval weight n (carry_mulmod f g)) mod (s - Associational.eval c) = (eval weight n f * eval weight n g) mod (s - Associational.eval c).

assumptions: Section mod_ops context: 0 < limbwidth_den <= limbwidth_num; s - Associational.eval c <> 0; s <> 0; n <> 0; length c = len_c; length idxs = len_idxs. Inputs f and g have length n. The carry schedule is the context value idxs.

reuse: When synthesizing a limb operation from an arithmetic specification, state the result as a weighted positional congruence for fixed-length inputs, and prove the carry schedule equivalent to the abstract modular operation using the existing evaluation and chained-carry lemmas.
